post.description: Creates a user account, returns an access token and sets the refresh cookie. Limited per client IP, with login: 429 with Retry-After beyond the limit.
Authenticates a user, returns an access token and sets the refresh cookie. Limited per client IP, with register: 429 with Retry-After beyond the limit.

Exchanges the refresh cookie for a new access token and a new refresh cookie. A refresh token used twice revokes its whole sign-in, except just after its first use: that is a race, answered with 409 and the cookie left alone, so retry. Requires the X-Requested-With header.
Revokes the sign-in of the refresh cookie and clears it. Requires the X-Requested-With header.

get.description: Returns the user attached to the bearer token.

post.description: Creates a workspace and adds the authenticated user as OWNER.

get.description: Lists only workspaces where the authenticated user is a member.
Returns a workspace only when the user belongs to it.

delete.description: Deletes a workspace. Only OWNER members can delete.

post.description: Adds the authenticated user as MEMBER using a one-time invitation code.
Creates a one-time invitation code. Only OWNER members can invite.

get.description: Lists members only when the authenticated user belongs to the workspace.

patch.description: Makes a member an OWNER or a MEMBER. Only OWNER members can change roles, and the last OWNER cannot be demoted (409). To hand a workspace over, make another member OWNER, then step down or leave.

delete.description: Removes a MEMBER from the workspace. Only OWNER members can remove members. Their card assignments are dropped and their projects go to the OWNER who removed them.

post.description: Removes the authenticated user from the workspace. Their card assignments are dropped and their projects go to the longest-standing OWNER. The last OWNER cannot leave (409).
Creates a project inside a workspace where the user is a member.

get.description: Lists projects only within the requested workspace membership scope.
Returns a project only when it belongs to the requested workspace and user membership scope.

patch.description: Updates project metadata, owner, or lifecycle status when the user is allowed to manage the project.

delete.description: Archives a project in workspace scope. Workspace owners or project owners can archive.
Permanently deletes a project in workspace scope. Only workspace OWNER members can delete permanently.

get.description: Returns every template with its lists and example cards.
Returns a full board with lists, cards, labels, and assignees.

post.description: Creates a project board and generates lists from the selected template.

get.description: Returns graph-derived planning signals for the board.

Returns the board's milestones, soonest target first, each with the dates its work is forecast to be done by (one chance in two, and 85%), the cards that drive those dates, and how many of its open cards have no size.
Returns the signed-in user's planning preferences for the board, or the defaults when none are saved.

put.description: Replaces the signed-in user's planning preferences for the board. Fields left out take their default.

patch.description: Renames a list, changes its task status or moves it. A status change completes or reopens its cards, as moving them would.

delete.description: Deletes a list. Its cards move to the list given by moveCardsTo, which is required when it has cards.

get.description: Returns safe dependency suggestions, blockers, and impacted dependents.

patch.description: Replaces the comment's text and records editedAt. Only the author can edit (403 for others).

delete.description: Deletes the comment. Only the author or a workspace OWNER can delete (403 for others).

post.summary: Propose what to cut from a milestone
post.description: Proposes cards to take out of the milestone so it has an 85% chance of shipping by its target date, giving up as little as possible: a card is worth its size, weighted by priority. Taking a card out also takes out the cards of the scope that depend on it, and those the milestone then no longer needs. Cards in progress, the cards in keep and whatever they need are never proposed. Changes nothing.

post.summary: Measure a cut of a milestone
post.description: Returns what taking the chosen cards out of the milestone would buy, as a proposal does. Changes nothing.
Takes the chosen cards out of the milestone: it stops depending on every card that leaves its scope with them. No card is deleted.

post.summary: Propose who does what on a milestone
post.description: Proposes which people should take which cards so the milestone ships soonest: its 85% date first, then its 50% one. A card only goes to one of the people named (by default whoever is assigned to an open card of the board, or the whole workspace when nobody is), preferably to someone who has completed cards with one of its labels. Cards in progress never move, nor cards that have assignees unless allowReassignment is set. Changes nothing.

post.summary: Measure who does what on a milestone
post.description: Returns what giving the chosen cards to the chosen people would buy, as a proposal does. Changes nothing.
Makes each chosen person the only assignee of their card.

get.description: Returns every open milestone's forecast, the cards of their scopes in the order to pick them up with who is expected to take each and when, and what the forecast assumes. The milestones share one team.

post.description: Returns the milestones' forecasts as they are and as they would be with the changes, on the same simulated runs, so the difference comes from the changes alone. Saves nothing. Changes that make cards depend on each other in a loop are refused (409).

get.summary: Get what the board has learned
get.description: Returns how long this team's cards take against what their size says, by size and label, and how often the board's past forecasts were met. Nothing in it compares people.

get.summary: List what happened to the board's cards
get.description: Returns a page of the board's history, oldest first: cards created, moved between task statuses, sized, linked, assigned or deleted. Pass nextAfter as after to get the next page.

get.summary: Rank what to do about a milestone
get.description: Returns the single steps that help the milestone most, the best first: taking a card out, giving a card to someone of the team, adding a person. Each is measured by forecasting the board with it, so they compare. Empty when nothing helps.

post.summary: Rank what to ask about a milestone
post.description: Returns the few answers that would make the milestone's date surest: a card to size or to split, a card in progress that drags on, a dependency that may be missing. dependencyHints adds dependencies someone suspects; they are weighed, not saved.

get.description: Ranks the signed-in user's cards across the workspace's active projects: what they are working on, what they can start next, and what is blocked. Each card keeps the score and reasons of its board's planning view.
